status: BLOCKED — specification of requirements, not a molecule design
purpose: Specify what the molecule MUST do. The actual molecule design is a medicinal chemistry research program.

functional_requirements.description: Molecule release rate from transducer must be monotonically increasing with applied pressure across the ICP range (0-50 mmHg).
functional_requirements.quantification: Sensitivity: dR/dP >= 0.1%/mmHg. Linear correlation R^2 > 0.95 across 5-40 mmHg.

functional_requirements.description: Molecule must be non-toxic, non-immunogenic, non-carcinogenic at concentrations required for sensing.
functional_requirements.quantification: ISO 10993 biocompatibility testing required. Cytotoxicity, sensitization, irritation, systemic toxicity, chronic implantation.

functional_requirements.description: Molecule must be detectable by a wearable (external) biosensor at nanomolar concentrations in interstitial fluid that equilibrates with CSF.
functional_requirements.quantification: Detection limit <= 10 nM. Selectivity >= 100x against common interferents (glucose, lactate, Na+, K+, Ca2+, urea, creatinine).

functional_requirements.description: Molecule must NOT be rapidly metabolized or chemically degraded in CSF. Half-life > 6 hours (so that a change in release rate produces a detectable concentration change before metabolism erases it).

functional_requirements.requirement: Clearance half-life suitable for ICP monitoring
functional_requirements.description: Molecule must clear from CSF (and from interstitial fluid at the wearable site) with half-life suitable for the monitoring timescale.
functional_requirements.quantification: t1/2_clearance in minutes-to-hours (NOT days — would accumulate; NOT seconds — would be too noisy). Target: 30-180 min.

functional_requirements.description: Molecule must be synthetically accessible in sufficient quantity for bench testing and eventual clinical use.
functional_requirements.quantification: Synthesis in <10 steps from commercial starting materials. Gram-scale at < $10K/gram.

functional_requirements.description: Molecule must be stable in storage (lyophilized or solution) for >12 months.

candidate_molecule_classes.evidence_for: Some fluorophores exhibit pressure-dependent fluorescence via molecular rotor mechanism.
candidate_molecule_classes.evidence_against: Sensitivity too low (typically 0.01%/mmHg, need 0.1%/mmHg). Many fluorophores are cytotoxic.
candidate_molecule_classes.key_question: Can a molecular-rotor fluorophore achieve 0.1%/mmHg sensitivity without cytotoxicity?

candidate_molecule_classes.evidence_for: Mechanophores release a small molecule when mechanically strained. Direct pressure-to-molecule transduction.
candidate_molecule_classes.evidence_against: Most mechanophores require very high strain (MPa range). ICP range (kPa) is too low to trigger most mechanophores.
candidate_molecule_classes.key_question: Can a mechanophore be designed with threshold in the kPa range?

candidate_molecule_classes.examples: Pegylated liposomes with pressure-triggered contents release
candidate_molecule_classes.evidence_for: Liposomes can be engineered to release contents at specific pressures.
candidate_molecule_classes.evidence_against: Threshold behavior is typically a step function, not proportional. Chronic stability unknown.
candidate_molecule_classes.key_question: Can a liposome be engineered for PROPORTIONAL (not threshold) release in the kPa range?

candidate_molecule_classes.evidence_against: Protein-based sensors are typically not pressure-responsive.

candidate_molecule_classes.evidence_for: Solid-liquid phase transition can be pressure-tuned.
candidate_molecule_classes.evidence_against: Hysteresis is severe. Not proportional. Chronic stability unknown.
candidate_molecule_classes.status: RESEARCH — likely unsuitable for proportional release

research_program_required.phase_1_literature_screening: 3-6 months. Screen all candidate classes against FR-01 through FR-07. Select top 3-5 candidates for synthesis.
research_program_required.phase_2_synthesis_and_bench_test: 6-12 months. Synthesize top candidates. Test pressure-release curve, CSF stability, biocompatibility.
research_program_required.phase_3_optimization: 6-12 months. Optimize lead candidate for sensitivity, half-life, biocompatibility.
research_program_required.phase_4_preclinical: 12-24 months. Animal model testing. Chronic implantation. Safety.
research_program_required.total_time_to_molecule_decision: 12-24 months to know if a viable molecule exists. May conclude 'no viable molecule' — P-09 dies.

what_unblocks_step_2_through_9: Selection of a specific molecule with measured pressure-release curve, CSF stability, and biocompatibility. Then concentration range, release kinetics, transport, clearance, sensor, inverse model, noise floor, and time resolution can all be derived.
